TestDistributedAggregates::test_retrying.description: 2-node cluster (2 racks, RF=2), insert 4 rows, SIGSTOP node2 (so node1 isn't told it stopped) and run SELECT count(*) via node1, asserting 4 rows. Intended to exercise mapreduce_service's retrying_dispatcher: the sub-request sent to node2 fails with rpc::closed_error (connection dropped when node2 is marked down) and is re-executed locally on the super-coordinator. Added while investigating scylladb#13276 (closed), where retrying_dispatcher's correctness was in doubt.

TestDistributedAggregates::test_retrying.description: 2-node cluster (1 rack, RF=1), insert 4 rows, SIGSTOP node2 and run SELECT COUNT(*) via node1, expecting NoHostAvailable or OperationTimedOut. Checks that when the node owning part of the data is really unavailable, the local retry on the super-coordinator can't help and the aggregation fails as a whole instead of returning a partial count.
